subject: c-cont
title: C.CONT.------INFO.DE.(B)
description: Diagram closing BK(NM)-5. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'it might be more useful to simply examine the cross-transfer implications of information exchange.' The crossing diagrams how composite-continuance structurally meets the black-information-descent at the cross-transfer-of-information-exchange scale: C-CONT (composite continuance — the form's actual continuance working) crossed with INFO-DE (information descent — the partner-axis with the (b) suffix marking this as the *black* information-descent specifically). C-CONT sits at top-center with the subject-arrow; HI-P (high purpose) at upper-left and VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) with AF-NT (affinity natural) at top-right as the partner-side upper outputs. SCI-DY (scientific dynamics) sits centrally as the bridging hub; RT-DY (reality dynamics) at left and EXP-DY (exposure dynamics) at center-right with T-C-IMP (temporal-continuity implication) and POL-IMP (political implication) below as the partner-side downward chain. AFI (affinity insight) hangs at lower-left and INFO-CON (information conservation) at lower-center-right with EXT-FT (extended functionalism) at the bottom-right as the bridging-axis downward chain. INFO-DE(B) sits at center-bottom as partner-axis terminus. Structural argument: when composite-continuance is crossed with the black-information descent, the upper diagonal HI-P → C-CONT → VT-DY → AF-NT is the *high-purpose route* — high-purpose routes through composite-continuance into vibrational-dynamics and finally into affinity-natural, the partner-side's working upward chain. SCI-DY hub holds the bridging diagonal: scientific-dynamics routes through EXP-DY into T-C-IMP and POL-IMP — the partner-axis converts the form's composite-continuance into political-implications via exposure-dynamics. HI-P → RT-DY → AFI on the left is what high-purpose produces alone through reality-dynamics into affinity-insight. INFO-CON → EXT-FT on the bottom-right is the bridging-bottom chain — information-conservation routes through extended-functionalism. The structural argument: the cross-transfer of information-exchange the prose names is structurally the configuration where SCI-DY's bridging hub converts the form's composite-continuance into political-implications via the partner-axis chain — the *information descent* term in the title is precisely the political-implications terminus, marking how black-creative-composers' composite-continuance arrives at the partner-axis as descended information, not as the working continuance the upper-diagonal would carry to vibrational-dynamics.
